snippet.title: All Hands on Deck - Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
snippet.description:
After years of development, our cozy co-op puzzle platformer All Hands on Deck is officially out! Play as Lefty and Righty — two helping hands on a mission to save missing plushies in playful worlds filled with puzzles, tools, and teamwork. Play locally, online, or via Remote Play Together

Buy now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122880/All_Hands_on_Deck

Buy now on Nintendo eShop:
NA: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/all-hands-on-deck-switch
EU: https://www.nintendo.com/nl-nl/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/All-Hands-on-Deck-2954542.html
